description: This file defines the ResourceQualifierSwitcher class, which provides UI components and logic for switching resource qualifiers in Android project view within an IDE, likely IntelliJ IDEA or Android Studio. It includes nested classes for UI panel and qualifier collection logic.

classes.name: ResourceQualifierSwitcher
classes.description: Provides resource qualifier switching UI in Android project view, including logic to collect qualifiers and display popup menu.

classes.name: ResourceQualifierSwitcher.ResourceQualifierSwitcherPanel
classes.description: UI panel component that displays current qualifier and allows user to select a different qualifier via popup menu.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key identifying the notification panel.

methods.name: createNotificationPanel
methods.description: Creates the UI notification panel if conditions are met (e.g., internal build, XML file, resource directory).

methods.name: collectQualifiers
methods.description: Collects resource qualifiers from resource directory matching the file's folder type.

methods.name: ResourceQualifierSwitcherPanel
methods.description: UI component class for displaying and switching resource qualifiers.

methods.name: ResourceQualifierSwitcherPanel
methods.description: Constructor setting up label and mouse listener for qualifier selection popup.

methods.name: switchToFile
methods.description: Opens the selected qualifier's resource file in the editor.
